  "guidance": "Complete the final report by: (1) finishing the 'Purchasing checklist — questions/specs to ask vendors' with a concrete, itemized list of vendor questions and specs (e.g., warranty terms, guaranteed cycle life, UL listings, operating temperature range, depth of discharge, round-trip efficiency, installation requirements, service/support availability, and warranty transferability). (2) Add a concise 'Next steps' section covering installation steps, warranty registration, service/support contacts, and end-of-life recycling. (3) Ensure markdown formatting is consistent throughout and that key sources (raw_research.md and quantitative_comparison.csv) are clearly cited near relevant claims. (4) Do a quick consistency check to ensure all numerical values and claims match the CSV data. (5) Return the revised, complete report."
